    My Progress

    Carry on next lesson

    At the end of each lesson, click 💾 Save progress file and keep the file in your OneDrive or school folder. Next lesson, on any computer, click 📂 Load progress file and choose it — your stars, programs and robot choices come back.

    Progress is also kept in this browser on this computer, but it can be cleared. Use the download buttons to hand in evidence on Compass. Each file has a Record ID that changes if the file is edited.
